definitions.drop: putting a captured piece from your hand back onto the board
definitions.hand: the pieces you have captured and can drop later
definitions.promote: upgrade a piece when it enters the promotion zone

beginner.guidance: Prefer everyday words. Use Shogi piece names (king, gold, silver, knight, lance, rook, bishop, pawn). At most one short term from allowed_terms if it helps. Do not invent drop rules.

definitions.promotion zone: the far three ranks where many pieces can promote
definitions.castle: a defensive king formation (e.g. simple gold/silver shelter)
definitions.sente: keeping the initiative / forcing the opponent to answer
definitions.fork: one piece attacks two targets at once
definitions.hanging: a piece is unprotected and can be taken

intermediate.guidance: Use club-level Shogi vocabulary from allowed_terms when accurate. Mention drops and the hand when relevant. Brief definitions optional if a term might confuse.

definitions.gote: the side answering / without the initiative
definitions.prophylaxis: preventing the opponent's plan before it happens
definitions.conversion: turning an advantage into a concrete win

advanced.guidance: Technical Shogi terms from allowed_terms are welcome when precise. Do not use chess-only jargon (castling, en passant, zwischenzug). Do not claim illegal drop mates. Stay accurate and concise.
